description.value: Mauna Sushi is a sushi restaurant operating out of the 108 Avenue corridor, with an active Square-based online ordering platform suggesting takeout availability. The restaurant serves a suburban strip that touring cyclists on the regional trail network may pass through. Little additional detail about the restaurant's menu or style is available from public sources.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies Mauna Sushi as a restaurant at 14839 108 Avenue; the discovered URL leads to an active Square online ordering site ('Order Now | Mauna Sushi'), confirming the business exists and takes orders. However, the fetched website content is almost entirely cookie-consent boilerplate with no substantive business details, so amenity fields cannot be confirmed from the website. The coordinates (49.1996, -122.8115) and 108 Avenue address place this business in Surrey, BC, not North Vancouver as listed in the OSM community field.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' but coordinates (49.1996, -122.8115) and address (108 Avenue) place this business in Surrey, BC — likely a data entry error in the community assignment.
Website content captured was almost entirely cookie-consent boilerplate; no menu, address, phone, or amenity details were extractable.
URL was discovered with only medium confidence and no phone or email is recorded in OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active sushi restaurant with a live online ordering website and a recent OSM check date; qualifies as a publicly accessible food stop for touring cyclists.
